turns.text: Hey Lloyd, my coffee maker is acting up again. Is there a quick fix for the grinder jam?
That is frustrating. Try unplugging it and manually rotating the burrs counter-clockwise to free any stuck beans.
That worked! Thanks. Now, I am trying to get a handle on Thinking Machines' Tinker cookbooks. I noticed they are cited as a prominent user of the renderer abstraction.
Understood. I will keep that architectural detail in mind for your future queries about their stack.
Cool. Also, did you see the weather forecast for next week? I hope the rain stops.
The forecast shows clear skies starting Tuesday, so your weekend plans should be safe.
Perfect. I need to order some new HDMI cables for the TV too. Do you have a link?
I can find a few highly-rated options if you specify the length and version you need.
Just the standard 6-foot ones are fine. Thanks, Lloyd.
You're welcome. I will search for those now.
